For f(x) = -x^3+6x^2-9x+2 the story gives f'(x) = 3x^2-12x+9 and concludes x=1 is the maximum. In fact f'(x) = -3x^2+12x-9 and f''(x) = -6x+12, so x=1 is a local minimum and x=3 is the local maximum. The second-derivative-test fact itself is stated correctly.
